name: anim_wani_grab
subject: a huge muscular crocodile monster made of thick pink and yellow marbled liquid paint, its lower body melting into a puddle, catching a small black witch cat
desc: Crashes into the small cat and wraps both arms around it, squashing it against its gooey chest; paint splatters and smears over the cat. Emphasize thick, sticky, viscous goo: paint stretching in strings, sagging, dripping and oozing with every movement.
